text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before we know it, it's already the final
evening
of summer camp.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I'm wrapping up strategies for the
upcoming
Kikuka Sho, I take a look
outside the window.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I let my eyes gaze across the night sky,
and a
thought crosses my mind.
choice_data_list: The stars are really out tonight...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That's right. Tonight is...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Ayabe! Sorry to have kept you
waiting!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It's fine... I wasn't waiting long.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
You probably got cornered by some
other
classmates, right?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It's you after all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you guessed right. I had to
handle a small
favor...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, let's hurry! It'll be lights-out
before we
know it.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure you want to go partner
running with
me... on the last night of
summer camp?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
You already improved so much during
our time
here.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Hmmm... Well, sure I have. But you could think of this as me gauging your improvement.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Besides... I really do want to run with
you. So let's
go!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
If I have to say it,
I've been itching to do
this!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Itching?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. After the Derby, I've been really
pushing
myself in training!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I want to see if I can catch up with
you. I
want to
measure how far I can go.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I've been itching to test my skills
against
you!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Heh.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Huh? H-hey, Ayabe! What are you
smiling for?!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Nothing. You just talk like a child

sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Heeey! I mean, we're not technically
adults yet
either, are we?

Haaah ha ha ha! I thought I heard the
sound of
cheerful chatter!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Th-that voice!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe and Top Road! You need not
explain
yourselves. Evidently, you desire
to take part...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
In the Overlord's parade to illuminate
the night
sky!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Wh-wh-whoa! Opera O's making the
fields sparkle
with light!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Opera O and Doto are having
fun like
always.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
If it's a comedy you desire, I shall
provide! Come,
Top Road! Tarry not and
join the line.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
When we march, you must
chant—OVERLORD!
OVERLORD!
O-VER, OVERLOOORD!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
OVERLORD! OVERLORD! OVER, OVER!
Lord,
lord...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Eek?! I-I messed it up!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Count me out.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Do not be shy, Ayabe! You are more
than
capable, which is why I called upon
you.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
While it is I, the Overlord, who shall
wipe away all shadows from the world,
you have earned the right to stand by
my side—an ally to my splendor that
lights even the moonless night!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's wrong, Ayabe?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega hurriedly scans the night
sky,
ignoring the confused faces of T.M.
Opera O and
the others.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Stars of all sizes shine and flicker so
brightly, one
could seemingly burn their
retinas from looking
too long.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But the moon—it's nowhere to be seen.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm coming to talk, on this
night of the
new moon.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
It's something I've always done, even
before I
knew about you.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Now it's my custom, a tradition I've
never broken
since learning what I lost.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (No, no, no—this can't be.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Did I... forget?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Huh?! Ayabe? Ayabeee!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
A-and there she goes. I wonder what's
wrong...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: She l-looked a little pale...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: The shadow of the Grim Reaper.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it was chasing her. No... She may
have
summoned it herself.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
A-are you s-saying... Ayabe might have
some
strange spirit following her?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Th-then, we have to go after her! It's
almost
lights-out—it's dangerous to go
out alone!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Stop. You mustn't follow her into the
darkness.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
We must wait in the light. You
understand, right,
Doto?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: O-Opera O... I understand...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ayabe...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff, huff!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(I have to get to higher ground... closer
to the
stars!)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (Closer to my sister... I have to hurry!)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...When did this start?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (It's still... hot.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(My throat, my chest... it feels like
they're
burning.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (Is this the same heat I felt during my debut race? Is this... your heat?)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
How much faster will she get by the time
the
Derby comes around?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Will our next race be even better than—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Since when did I...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
After all, I want everyone to compete
with
everything they've got—including
me!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (Compete... with everything I've got...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Since when did I forget my sins—my
duty?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Since when did I forget my whole
purpose for
being alive?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I look forward to running with you today!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Let's give it our best shot.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I started running for my own satisfaction,
out of
my own desire, for my own
pleasure...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: For myself!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: How dare I live... for myself.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff... Wheeze...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I'm s—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry!
Ayabe...
Ayabe, what's wrong?
